primitives.name: Launch Readiness Score
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Operations / Founder Cockpit As of: 2026-06-09 ## Mission Owns operating cadence, decision logs, launch dashboard, and department coordination.
primitives.assumptions: R is a monotonic function of verified test coverage, blocker count, and compliance status.
primitives.breakdown_regime: R < 0.5 indicates critical launch blocker presence.

layer2.mapping: R maps to GSI's probabilistic readiness inference, where R = P(verified | evidence), and GSE transitions to 'blocked' when R drops below threshold.

primitives.name: Build Card State Transition
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Definition Of Done The change is implemented or explicitly blocked, tested, documented, screenshot/source verified if relevant, and reflected in the command center.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S(t)': 'State of build card at time t (set: {ready, in_progress, blocked, done})'}
primitives.assumptions: State transitions governed by conditional logic of test results, documentation, and command center reflection.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Transition S(t) → S(t+1) fails if any acceptance criterion is unmet.

layer2.mapping: S(t) evolves in GSE as a Markov chain over build artifacts, with kernel defined by test evidence and approval gates.
layer2.telemetry: Build card status, test evidence, approval timestamps

primitives.name: Escalation Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Escalation Rules Escalate legal/compliance, deploy, production data, payments, live affiliate, method leakage, or P0 data accuracy problems immediately.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E(t)': 'Escalation event at time t (boolean vector of problem types)'}
primitives.assumptions: E(t) triggers immediate state change in operational workflow if any P0 condition is met.
primitives.breakdown_regime: E(t) = true when any element of E(t) is true, causing system-wide halt.

layer2.mapping: E(t) mirrors GSI's anomaly detection thresholds, triggering GSE to enter emergency mode and halt non-critical builds.
layer2.telemetry: Event flags, P0 data accuracy, compliance status
